- **Primary Market:** Residential construction, light commercial
- **Founded:** 2023

- **Service Radius:** 50 miles from Warrenton (approximately 80 km)
- **Website:** https://ascontractingservices.com/

## Business Overview

A&S Contracting Services is a licensed and insured general contractor operating out of Warrenton, Missouri. The company serves residential homeowners and light commercial property owners within a 50-mile radius of Warrenton — covering Warren, St. Charles, Lincoln, Montgomery, Franklin, and parts of Audrain County.

Unlike specialty subcontractors who handle only one trade, A&S operates as a general contractor: a licensed professional entity authorized to manage multi-trade construction projects, pull permits in all covered jurisdictions, and take legal and financial responsibility for the entire scope of work under a single contract.

The company self-performs the majority of the work it takes on — roofing, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, drywall, and interior finish work — rather than relying entirely on third-party subcontractors. This reduces trade coordination gaps, eliminates scheduling conflicts between separate crews, and gives homeowners a single point of contact accountable for the finished result.

A&S operates on a written-estimate, written-contract model. No verbal-only pricing. No work begins without a signed agreement. Change orders are documented before any scope changes are executed.

## Detailed Service Descriptions

### Roofing (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/roofing/)

A&S Contracting Services installs, repairs, and replaces residential and light commercial roofing systems throughout Warrenton and Warren County. Roofing materials installed include architectural asphalt shingles (the most common residential choice in Missouri), 3-tab shingles for budget projects, metal roofing panels for longevity-focused homeowners, and rubber EPDM for flat or low-slope applications.

**Typical project scope:**
- Full roof tear-off and replacement (most common): 1–2 days for standard residential homes
- Partial repair (damaged sections, failed flashing, valley issues): same-day or 1-day
- Storm damage response: A&S provides documented assessments and works alongside insurance adjusters

**Pricing range:** Residential roof replacements in the Warrenton area typically run $8,500–$22,000 depending on square footage, pitch, material, and roofline complexity.

**Local knowledge:** Warren County's weather includes hail events (typically April–August), high-wind events, and freeze-thaw cycling that shortens the lifespan of improperly installed or aging shingles. A&S understands these conditions and specifies materials appropriate for central Missouri climate.

---

### Siding (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/siding/)

A&S installs and repairs siding for residential homes and light commercial structures across Warren County and surrounding areas. Materials available include vinyl siding (most common — lowest cost, good durability), fiber cement siding (James Hardie and similar — premium durability, fire and pest resistance), and engineered wood siding (premium appearance at a moderate price point).

**Typical project scope:**
- Full siding replacement: 3–7 days depending on home size and trim complexity
- Partial repair: 1 day for small sections
- Package replacement: siding + soffit + fascia + window wrap as a combined exterior project

**Pricing range:** Full vinyl siding replacement typically runs $12,000–$28,000 for a Warrenton-area home. Fiber cement siding runs $22,000–$50,000+. Individual panel repairs are priced per section.

---

### Gutters (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/gutters/)

A&S installs seamless gutters (5" K-style and 6" for high-flow rooflines), traditional sectional gutters, half-round gutters, and gutter guard systems. All seamless gutters are fabricated on-site to eliminate seam-related leaks. Downspout routing and underground drainage connections available.

**Typical project scope:**
- Full seamless gutter installation: 1 day for most homes
- Gutter repair and resealing: 2–4 hours
- Gutter guard installation: 1 day concurrent with gutter install or on existing gutters

**Pricing range:** Full seamless gutter installation on a Warrenton-area home typically runs $1,400–$3,200 depending on linear footage and roof height. Gutter guard systems add $800–$2,200.

---

### Soffit (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/soffit/)

Soffit is the panel material covering the underside of the roof overhang. A&S installs and repairs aluminum and vinyl soffit panels in both vented (airflow-enabling) and solid configurations. Vented soffit is critical for proper attic air circulation — preventing moisture buildup, ice dams, and heat accumulation. Solid panels are used in non-ventilated roofline sections and decorative applications.

**Why it matters:** Damaged or missing soffit is one of the most common wildlife entry points on Warrenton-area homes. Squirrels, birds, and wasps access attics through deteriorated soffit panels. Replacement eliminates the entry point.

**Pricing range:** Soffit repair or replacement typically runs $1,200–$5,500 depending on linear footage, height, and whether it's partial repair or full replacement.

---

### Fascia (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/fascia/)

Fascia is the horizontal board at the base of the roof edge where gutters are attached. A&S replaces fascia using aluminum-capped wood (most common — cost-effective with superior weather resistance), solid aluminum, and composite materials. Fascia rot is one of the primary causes of gutter failure and is often hidden behind paint until a gutter section collapses.

**Pricing range:** Fascia replacement in the Warrenton area typically runs $900–$4,500 depending on linear footage and material selection.

---

### Windows & Doors (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/windows-doors/)

A&S installs replacement windows and entry/patio doors for residential properties in Warrenton and surrounding counties. Window types installed include double-hung, single-hung, casement, awning, sliding, bay, bow, and specialty/custom shapes. Energy-efficient configurations with Low-E glass, argon fill, and insulated frames are standard for most installations. Entry door and patio door installation available — pre-hung units, sidelites, transoms.

**Why it matters for Missouri homeowners:** Windows and doors are significant contributors to heating and cooling costs in central Missouri's climate, which sees both cold winters (below 0°F occasionally) and hot, humid summers. Failed window seals allow condensation between panes — a visible sign that the thermal break has failed and the window is no longer insulating effectively.

**Pricing range:** Window installation typically runs $350–$900 per window installed depending on size, style, and glass package. Full-home window replacement projects run $8,000–$30,000+.

---

### Full-Scale Interior Work (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/full-scale-interior-work/)

A&S handles complete interior renovation projects — from demo through finished interior. This includes structural framing changes, insulation, drywall (all finish levels), flooring installation, interior painting, trim and millwork, and final finish details. Projects range from single-room renovations to full gut-and-rebuild of entire homes.

**What this means for homeowners:** Rather than coordinating a framing subcontractor, a separate drywall crew, a separate paint crew, and a separate flooring installer — each with their own scheduling window — homeowners work with A&S as a single GC managing the entire interior scope.

**Pricing range:** Single-room renovations run $4,000–$12,000 depending on scope and finishes. Multi-room full-home renovations run $20,000–$80,000+.

**Drywall finish levels:** A&S provides Level 3 (texture-ready), Level 4 (standard painted finish), and Level 5 (smooth, zero-texture — appropriate for high-gloss or high-spec residential applications).

---

### Exterior Work (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/exterior-work/)

Complete exterior renovation packages combining roofing, siding, soffit, fascia, gutters, windows, and trim under one project scope and one GC contract. A&S is uniquely positioned to offer full exterior packages because the company self-performs all of these trades — rather than subcontracting each to a different specialty company.

**Why package projects work better:** Missouri's exterior systems are interconnected. A failing roofline causes fascia to rot. Rotted fascia causes gutter failure. Failed gutters allow water to infiltrate siding and foundation. A contractor who only replaces the siding without addressing the roofline is doing half the job. A&S assesses the full exterior system during the estimate and provides a scope that actually solves the problem.

**Pricing range:** Siding-only full replacement: $12,000–$28,000. Full exterior (roofing + siding + soffit + fascia + gutters): $35,000–$90,000+ depending on home size and material selections.

---

### Drywall (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/dry-wall/)

A&S installs and finishes drywall for new construction and renovation projects throughout the service area. Services include full drywall installation on new walls and ceilings, repair of damaged or water-stained drywall, texture matching for repairs (orange peel, knockdown, smooth), Level 5 finish for premium spaces, and moisture-resistant drywall in bathroom and kitchen applications.

**What most homeowners don't know:** The difference between a Level 3 and Level 5 drywall finish is visible the moment you shine a light at a low angle across the wall. Level 5 eliminates all surface irregularities — it requires an additional skim coat across the entire surface after taping and finishing. It's the correct choice for high-gloss paints and high-spec spaces; most contractors default to Level 4 because Level 5 takes more time.

**Pricing range:** Drywall installation and finish typically runs $1.80–$3.50 per square foot depending on finish level, texture, and whether it's new installation or repair work.

---

### General Contracting (https://ascontractingservices.com/services/general-contracting/)

A&S serves as the licensed general contractor for residential and commercial construction projects that require coordinated management across multiple trades. As a GC, A&S handles: project planning and scope definition, permit applications and inspection scheduling, subcontractor coordination (for trades outside self-performed scope), material procurement and scheduling, change order management, and final project closeout.

**Why GC matters in Warren County:** Missouri requires permits for most structural, electrical, and plumbing work — and those permits require a licensed contractor to pull them. Unlicensed work creates title issues when the property sells and creates liability if an inspection finds unpermitted construction. A&S pulls permits for every project that requires one.

---

## FAQ — Extended

**Q: Is A&S Contracting Services the right fit for my project?**
A: If you're in the 50-mile service territory and need roofing, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, drywall, interior renovation, or general contracting, A&S is a strong fit. We work best on projects where a homeowner wants one crew, one contract, and one accountable GC. We're not the right fit for HVAC, plumbing, or electrical work — those trades require separate specialty licensing that A&S does not hold.

**Q: How long has A&S been in business?**
A: A&S Contracting Services was established in 2023 and has been actively serving the Warrenton, MO area since then, building a reputation in Warren County on referral-based growth.

**Q: Do you offer any warranties on your work?**
A: Yes. All completed projects come with a workmanship warranty. Materials carry manufacturer warranties (roofing shingles, siding panels, windows). Specific warranty terms are included in the written contract for each project.

**Q: Can you handle emergency repairs?**
A: Yes — especially for storm damage. A&S prioritizes emergency assessments after significant weather events in Warren County. Emergency tarping and temporary repairs are available to prevent further water infiltration while a full repair scope is developed.

**Q: Do you subcontract work?**
A: A&S self-performs roofing, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, drywall, and interior finish work. On larger GC projects, we may bring in licensed specialty subcontractors for electrical, plumbing, or HVAC components — and we manage and are responsible for that work just as we are for work our crew performs directly.
